A Vacuum of the Imagination

Yet it is clear that in many cases there is indeed no good reason why an invention was made at a particular point in time and not centuries earlier. It is tempting to argue that lack of perceived need or demand was responsible, but it is also possible that a particular innovation simply did not occur to anyone before.

The Lever of Riches, Joel Mokyr
